title.zh: 广播（第二附表修正）公告 1998
title.en: BROADCASTING AMENDMENT OF SECOND SCHEDULE NOTIFICATION 1998

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-46-1998-BROADCASTING-AMENDMENT-OF-SECOND-SCHEDULE-NOTIFICATION-1998.pdf》（1 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Notification may be cited as the Broadcasting (Amendment of Citation and Second Schedule) Notification, 1998 and shall commence on the 1st. day commencement. of December, 1998.

The Second Schedule to the Emergency (Broadcasting) Order, 1997 is Amendment of amended by inserting, immediately after item 19, the following item-Second Schedule. "20. Computer on-line services.". Made this l.Oth. day of Ramadan 1419 Hijriah corresponding to the 29th. day of December, 1998. PEHIN ORANG KAYA LAlLA SETIA BAKTI DIRAJA DATO LAlLA UTAMA HAJI A WANG ISA BIN PEHIN DATU PERDANA MANTER! DATO LAlLA UTAMA HAJI IBRAHIM Minister responsible for broadcasting matters, Prime Minister's Office, Brunei Darussalam.
